newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Innogenetics says some investors to sell.
newsitem.headline: Innogenetics says some investors to sell.

text.p: Belgian, Easdaq-listed biotech company Innogenetics NV said on Monday that some of its core investors were looking to reduce their holdings.

"Innogenetics is aware that certain existing shareholders, who invested in Innogenetics as a start-up company, now wish to sell shares following the expiry of the lock-up period on May 28, 1997," the company said in a statement.

Innogenetics said it was in talks with other potential buyers. "It is the intention that any shares held by these shareholders, which are not sold as part of this process, will be locked up for a further six months," it added.
